 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Heritage Energy | Divine Prosperity | Artistic Luxury

जहाँ परंपरा मिले ऊर्जा से, वहाँ बनता है एक ऐसा स्पेस जो सिर्फ सुंदर नहीं, बल्कि अर्थपूर्ण भी होता है —
and the Heritage Frame Trio (Pack of 3) is thoughtfully curated to bring together sacred symbolism, artistic legacy, and powerful crystal energy into one harmonious décor statement.

This premium set features three distinct yet beautifully connected crystal décor frames — inspired by Gond Art, Phad Art, and Madhubani Art, each representing India’s rich storytelling traditions through intricate detailing, nature-inspired motifs, and symbolic expressions.

From the Tree of Life and deer motifs symbolising growth, grace, and stability…
to the Airavata elephant representing strength, protection, royalty, and abundance…
to the sacred Shank, a symbol of purity, auspicious beginnings, and spiritual balance —
each frame carries its own powerful meaning while together creating a complete energy circle of harmony, prosperity, and strength.

Infused with 100% natural Pyrite crystal, widely known as the “wealth magnet,” this trio works as a powerful energy décor set that supports confidence, financial growth, positive energy flow, and grounded decision-making. It also aligns with Vastu and Feng Shui principles, helping create a balanced, protected, and energetically uplifting environment.

Perfect for your living room, workspace, entrance, or spiritual corner, this trio transforms your space into a blend of heritage art, divine symbolism, and modern luxury décor.

Handcrafted by India’s biggest crystal home décor brand, ensuring premium quality, precision, and refined craftsmanship. Each piece carries natural textures, unique variations, and authentic crystal energy, making every set one of a kind.

A collection not just for decoration, but for inviting prosperity, protection, wisdom, and meaningful living into your space ✨

Disclaimer:
• Crystals work best when paired with your intentions and consistent efforts. They are meant to support your journey, not replace your hard work.
• Results may vary from person to person.
• As natural materials are used, slight variations in colour, texture, and detailing may occur.

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1) What makes this décor piece unique?

This piece features intricate artwork, layered detailing, and nature-inspired motifs, giving it a premium, artistic, and timeless appeal.

2) What do the tree and deer symbols represent?

The Tree of Life represents growth, stability, and continuous expansion, while the deer symbolize peace, grace, and balance*, making it a powerful symbol of harmony and progress.

3) What is Gond Art?

Gond Art is a traditional tribal art form from Madhya Pradesh, known for its nature-inspired motifs, detailed patterns, and storytelling through animals, trees, and symbolic elements.

4) How do I maintain this piece?

Clean gently using a soft, dry cloth. Avoid water, moisture, or harsh chemicals to maintain its finish and detailing.

5) How can I energetically cleanse it?

You can place it on a selenite recharging plate or keep it under moonlight overnight to refresh its energy.

6) Is this a religious product?

No, this is a symbolic and decorative energy piece, suitable for both spiritual alignment and modern home décor styling.
